suspectedOrigin: M4 publication service calls SqliteProducerLocalStore.getSpace() without spaceId. Its LIMIT 1 query selects the empty 4d space rather than the populated 1024d space; Builder then compares every 1024d BLOB to dimension 4.
evidence: Read-only SQLite query: embedding_records count=2299; length(embedding_blob)/4=1024 for all records.
src/index/sqliteProducerLocalStore.ts getSpace() uses LIMIT 1 when no spaceId is supplied.
